spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (औ) पदौ (पद्व्यते) r. 10th cl. (पदयते)
To go, to move.
(ए) पदे r. 1st cl. (पदति)
To stand fast.
With अभि prefixed,
1 To know, to understand.
2 To see, to look.
With अनु,
To follow.
With आङ्,
1 To happen, to befall.
2 To gain.
3 To suffer misfortune.
4 To multiply.
5 To produce.
6 To come.
With उत्,
To be born or produced.
With उप,
1 To gain.
2 To be born.
3 To be near or connected with.
With उप and सम्,
To offer oblations.
With प्र,
1 To gain, to acquire.
2 To commence.
With प्र and वि,
To establish, to enact.
With प्रति,
1 To gain.
2 To assent, to agree or promise.
3 To restore.
With वि,
To suffer misfortune or pain.
With वि and आङ्,
To injure or kill.
With वि and उत्,
To discriminate, to analyze.
With सम्,
1 To thrive, to grow or increase.
2 To do, to execute, to perform.
3 To select.
With सम् and आङ्,
1 To arrive.
2 To finish.

n. (-दं)
1 A foot.
2 A footstep, the mark of a foot.
3 A word.
4 An inflected word.
5 A crude word.
6 A connected sentence.
7

Thing.
8

Preservation, defence.
9 Industry, application.
10

Disguise.
11

Place, site.
12 Rank, station, degree.
13 A mark, a spot.
14 A foot or rather line of a stanza.
15 A mode of writing the Vedas, in which the several words are detached from one another.
16 (In Arithmetic,) Any one of a set of numbers the sum of which is required, or the last of the series.
m. (-दः)
A ray of light.
E.
पद to go, aff. अच् or घञ्.

m. (-दः)
1 A foot.
2 A quarter.
3 A hill at the foot of a mountain.
4 A ray of light.
5 The root of a tree.
6 The foot or line of a stanza.
7 The line of a hymn or stanza of the Ṛg

Veda.
8

The quadrant of a circle.
E.
पद to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-द् or त्)
A foot.
E.
पद to go, aff. क्विप्; also पद; or it is considered an irregular substitute for पाद.

m. (-पाद् or पात्)
The foot.
E.
पद to go, aff. क्विप्, and the radical vowel made long.

m. (-कः)
1 A Brahman knowing the verses of the

Vedas.
2

A Niṣka, a weight of gold.
3 An ornament of the neck.
E.
पद a verse, &c. and कन् aff.

m. (-रः)
One who divides or separates compound terms.
E.
पद, and कार who makes.

m. (-मः)
1 Step, pace.
2 Walking.
E.
पद, and क्रम going.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going with the feet.
m. (-गः)
A footman, a foot soldier, &c.
E.
पद् or पद a foot, and ग who goes; hence also पद्ग.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone on foot.
2 Described or recorded in a line or stanza.
E.
पद, and गत gone.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Who or what goes or moves.
E.
पद to go, युच् aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Step, pace.
2 Conduct, procedure.
3 Position of the feet in a particular attitude.
4 A plant; also गोक्षुर.
E.
पद, and न्यास gesticulation.

m. (-तः)
Step, pace, foot-fall, tread.
E.
पद, and पात fall.

n. (-नं)
1 Explanation of obscure or obsolete words.
2

Etymology.
3

Separating the words of a line or sentence.
E.
पद a word, भञ्जन a breaking.

f. (-का)
A register, a journal, a calendar or almanack.
E.
पद a mark, &c. भञ्ज to divide, aff. वुन्.

f. (-विः-वी)
1 A road, a path, a way.
2 Station, situation, degree, rank.
3 Place, site.
E.
पद to go, अवि aff.; fem. aff. optionally ङीप्.

m. (-पः)
1 Step, pace, walking.
2 A horse's paces.
E.
पद, and विक्षेप throwing.

m. (-म्भः)
Tread, step, stamp with the foot.
E.
पद, and विष्टम्भ fixing.

n. (-वं)
The feet and knees.
E.
पद् a foot, and अष्ठीवत् the knee, deriv. irr.

m. (-तः)
A writer, an annotator, one who collects or classes words.
E.
पद, and सम् before हन to hurt, अण् aff. also पदसङ्घाट.

m. (-ङ्कः)
Foot-mark, vestige.
E.
पद, and अङ्क a mark.

m. (-जिः)
A foot soldier.
E.
पद a foot, अज to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तः)
A footman, a pedestrian.
E.
पद foot, अत to go, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-तः)
A foot-soldier, a footman.
n. (-तं)
Infantry.
E.
पाद, and अत to go, aff. अच्, or पदाति a foot-soldier, अण् collective aff.

m. (-तिः)
A footman or foot soldier.
E.
पद foot, अत to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तिः)
A foot-soldier, a man on foot, or footman.
E.
पाद with अत to go, aff. इन्; also पदाति; also with कन् added, पादातिक m. (-कः)

m. (-कः)
A peon, a footman or foot soldier.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-गः)
1 A servant.
2 An army.
E.
पद, and अनुराग attachment.

n. (-जं)
The foot of a mistress, or a divinity, &c.
E.
पद, and अम्भोज lotus; also similar compounds, पदारविन्द, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 The dust of the feet.
2 A boat.
E.
पद a foot, ऋ to go, घञ् aff.

n. (-न्दं)
The foot of a mistress, of a divinity, &c.
E.
पद, and अरविन्द a lotus.

m. (-र्थः)
1 Thing, substantial or material form of being.
2 A category or predicament in Logic, of which seven are enumerated, viz. substance, quality, action, identity, variety, relation, and annihilation; another enumeration gives sixteen.
3 The meaning of a word or sentence.
E.
पद word, thing, and अथ meaning.

n. (-नं)
A footstool.
E.
पद a foot, आसन a place of sitting.

n. (-नं)
A foot-stool.
E.
पाद, and आसन a seat.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Going on foot.
m. (-कः)
A foot soldier.
n. (-कं)
The point of the foot.
E.
पद a foot, aff. ष्ठन्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fourth, a fourth.
E.
पाद a quarter, and ठक् aff.

ind.
Continually.
E.
पद a foot-step, seventh case, repeated.

m. (-द्गः)
A foot soldier.
E.
पद a foot, and ग who goes.

f. (-तिः-ती)
1 A road.
2 A line, a row or range.
3 A ritual, a manual, a work upon any act or ceremony, detailing the mode of its performance, and collecting the texts connected with it.
4 A family name, a surname or title.
E.
पद a foot, हन to strike, aff. क्तिन्.

n. (-मं)
Coldness of the feet.
E.
पद् for पाद, and हिम frost or cold.

mn. (-द्मः-द्मं)
1 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum); it is often confounded with the water lily, (Nymphæa.)
2 A form of array.
3 One of KUVERA'S treasures or gems.
4 A large number, ten billions.
5 Coloured marks on the face and trunk of an elephant.
6 A drug, also termed Padmakāṣṭha.
7

Lead.
8

A name given to the six Cakras of the body, or to the mystical faculties present in them.
m. (-द्मः)
1 A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions.
2 One of the twelve Cakravartīs or paramount princes of the

Jainas.
3
One of the nine persons termed Śukla Balas by the

Jainas.
4
A name of

RĀMA.
5

The personified treasure of KUVERA, as worshipped by the Tāntrikas.
f. (-द्मा)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
3 A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
4 A female serpent or Nāga, the goddess MANASĀ, and wife to the sage

JARATKĀRU.
5

The mother of the twentieth Jina or Jaina saint.
6 The flower of the Carthamus or safflower.
E.
पद to go, (on the water, &c.) Uṇādi aff. मम्.

n. (-कं)
1 Coloured marks or spots on the face and trunk of an elephant.
2 A sort of drug, commonly called पद्मकाष्ठ.
3 A kind of leprosy.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
पद्म, and कर hand, his image always holding a lotus in one hand.

m. (-रः)
A large deep tank or pond; one in which the lotus does or may grow.
E.
पद्म, and आकर a mine.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A fragrant wood used in medicine, and described as cooling and tonic.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and काष्ठ wood.

m. (-की)
The Bhojpatra or birch tree, the bark is used for writing upon, &c.
E.
पद्मक, and इनि aff.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The filaments of a lotus.
E.
पद्म, and केशर the same.

n. (-ण्डं)
A quantity of lotuses, or spot abounding with them.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and खण्ड a portion or district.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Lotus-smelling; smelling like a lotus.
E.
पद्म, and गन्ध smell; also with इ substituted for the final. पद्मगन्धि.

m. (-र्ब्भः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

The sun.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and गर्ब्भ womb, born from the lotus.

f. (-णी)
A small tree, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
E.
पद्म a lotus, चर to resemble, aff. णिनि, fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-न्तुः)
The fibrous stalk of the lotus.
E.
पद्म, and तन्तु thread.

m. (-नः)
The resin of the Pinus longifolia.

m. (-भः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

One of the Jinas of a future age.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and नाभि a navel, षच् aff.; also

m. (-भिः)
VIṢṆU is thus termed, because the lotus, containing BRAHMĀ, sent to create the world, sprang from his navel.

n. (-लं)
The stalk of a lotus.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and नाल a hollow stalk.

n. (-बं)
A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
पद्म a lotus, and पत्र a leaf; also पद्मपर्ण n. (-र्णं) from पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-णिः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

The sun.
3 A Buddha, a Bauddha sanctified teacher.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and पाणि the hand, holding a lotus in one hand.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 A shrub, (Webera corymbosa): see कर्णिकार.
2 A sort of bird.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-भः)
The sixth Jina or Jaina pontiff.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and प्रभ who shines.

f. (-या)
The wife of the Muni JARATKĀRU.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and प्रिया fond of.

m. (-न्धः)
The arrangement of the words of a verse in a figure representing the leaves of a lotus.
E.
पद्म, and बन्ध binding.

m. (-न्धुः)
1 A bee.
2 The sun.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and बन्धु the friend.

m. (-भूः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and भू born.

f. (-खी)
A sort of prickly nightshade.

m. (-निः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
पद्म, and योनि place of production.

m. (-गः)
A ruby.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and राग colour.

f. (-खा)
A line of the palm, indicating the possession of great wealth.
E.
पद्म a large number, and रेखा a line.

m. (-नः)
1 A king, a sovereign.
2 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
3

The sun.
4 KUVERA, the god of wealth.
f. (-ना)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 A name of SARASVATĪ.
3 A title of TĀRĀ, one of the forms of DURGĀ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, a Catta or parasol shaped like one, a fabulous gem, &c. and लाञ्छन a mark or designation.

n. (-कं)
A species of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
पद्म a lotus, वर्ण a colour, कन् aff.

f. (-सा)
A name of LAKṢMĪ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and वास abode; abiding at the creation within the petals of the lotus.

n. (-जं)
The seed of the lotus.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and वीज seed.

f. (-षा)
1 GAṄ

GĀ.
2

LAKṢMĪ.
3 GAURĪ or DURGĀ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and स्नुषा a daughter-in-law.

m. (-क्षः)
The seed of the lotus.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and अक्ष an eye.

m. (-टः)
A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.)
E.
पद्म a lotus, and अट to resemble, aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
Petal of the lotus.
E.
पद्म, and अन्तर inside.

f. (-या)
A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and आलय an asylum.

f. (-ती)
1 The wife of the sage

JARATKĀRU.
2

The name of a river, the main stream of the Ganges, between the Kasimbazar river and the sea.
E.
पद्म a lotus, मतुप् aff., fem. aff. ङीप्, and the antepen. made long.

m. (-यः)
The Muni JARATKĀRU.
E.
पद्मावती as above, and प्रिय beloved.

n. (-नं)
A posture in religious meditation, sitting with the thighs crossed, one hand resting on the left thigh, the other held up with the thumb upon the heart; the eyes directed to the tip of the nose.
2 A seat or throne made in the shape of a lotus, one especially on which idols are placed.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

The sun.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and आसन sitting.

m. (-द्मी)
An elephant.
f. (-नी)
1 A multitude of lotuses, or place abounding in them.
2 A woman of one of the four classes into which the sex is distinguished; the first and most excellent.
3 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)
4 A pool or pond, especially one deep enough for the growth of the lotus.
5 The fibrous stalk of a lotus.
6 A female elephant.
E.
पद्म coloured marks, &c. or a lotus, इनि aff.

m. (-न्तः)
The sun.
E.
पद्मिनी a lotus, and कान्त beloved.

n. (-ण्डं)
A place abounding with lotuses, or a district in which they grow.
E.
पद्मिनी, and खण्ड division.

m. (-भः)
The sun.
E.
पद्मिनी a lotus, and बल्लभ a friend.

m. (-यः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
पद्मे in or on a lotus, and शय who sleeps.

Safflower.
2

A proper name: see the next.
E.
पद्म, and उत्तर better.

m. (-जः)
One of the Jaina Cakravartīs or emperors.
E.
पद्मोत्तर, and आत्मज son.

m. (-वः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
f. (-वा)
The snake goddess MANASĀ.
E.
पद्म a lotus, and उद्भव born.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्याद्यं)
Hurting or coming in contact with the feet.
n. (-द्यं)
1 Metre, verse.
2 Wickedness, infamy.
m. (-द्यः)
A Śūdra.
f. (-द्या)
1 A road.
2 Praise, eulogium.
E.
पद to go, यत् aff.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Water, &c. for cleaning the feet.
E.
पाद the foot, यत् aff.

m. (-द्रः)
1 A village.
2 The entrance into a village.
E.
पद to go, रक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-द्वः)
1 The abode or world of human beings.
2 A car.
3 A road.
E.
पद to go, क्वन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-द्वा)
A road.
E.
पद to go, वनिप् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
An ornament for the feet or toes.
E.
पाद a foot, and कटक a bracelet.

n. (-च्छ्रं)
A sort of penance, eating once and fasting on alternate nights.
E.
पाद a quarter, and कृच्छ्र penance.

m. (-रः)
Morbid enlargement of the legs and feet.
E.
पाद the foot, गण्ड a swelling, इरन् aff.

n. (-णं)
Respectful obeisance, touching the feet of a Brahman or superior.
E.
पाद, and ग्रहण taking.

m. (-रः)
1 A goat.
2 A sand bank.
3 The religious fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
4

Hail.
5

A slanderer, a calumniator.
E.
पाद the foot, and चत्वर levelled ground.

n. (-ल्यं)
Beating or shuffling with the feet.
E.
पाद a foot, &c. चापल्य unsteadiness.

n. (-रं)
1 The daily position of the planets.
2 Going on foot.
E.
पाद, and चार going.

m. (-री)
A footman, a foot-soldier.
E.
पाद, and चर to go, aff. णिनि.

m. (-जः)
A Śūdra, or man of the fourth and servile tribe.
E.
पाद the foot, (of BRAHMĀ,) and ज born.

n. (-लं)
1 The sole or the lower part of the foot.
adv.
As low as or under the feet.
E.
पाद, and तल below.

ind.
1 At the foot.
2 By or with a quarter.
E.
पाद, and तसि aff.

n. (-णं)
A boot, a shoe.
E.
पाद the foot, and त्राण preserving.

f. (-री)
A chap in the feet, a chilblain.
E.
पाद, दृ to rend, अण् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 A tree.
2 A foot-stool, a cushion, &c. for the feet.
f. (-पा)
A shoe, a slipper.
E.
पाद a foot, or root, and पा to drink or preserve, aff. क.

n. (-नं)
Trampling, treading upon.
E.
पाद, and परिघट्टन friction.

f. (-हा)
A creeping or a parasite plant.
E.
पादप a tree, and रुह what mounts.

m. (-शः)
1 A foot-rope for cattle or horses.
2 An anklet of small bells, &c.
f. (-शी)
1 A chain for the feet, a fetter.
2 A foot-carpet or mat.
E.
पाद the foot, and पाश a fetter.

m. (-ठः)
A foot-stool.
E.
पाद, and पीठ a stool.

f. (-का)
1 Any common or vulgar trade, as that of a barber, &c.
2 A white-stone.
E.
पादपीठ a foot-stool, a work bench, ङीप् depreciative aff., and कन् added.

n. (-नं)
Washing the feet.
E.
पाद, and प्रक्षालन washing.

m. (-मः)
Bowing to the feet, prostration.
E.
पाद, and प्रणाम bowing.

n. (-णं)
A shoe.
E.
पाद, and प्रधारण defending.

m. (-रः)
A kick.
E.
पाद the foot, and प्रहार striking.

n. (-नं)
Stock of cattle.
E.
पाद a foot, and बन्धन binding, alluding to the foot-ropes with which cattle are tied.

n. (-लं)
The heel.
E.
पाद the foot, and मूल the root.

n. (-णं)
A leather boot or shoe.
E.
पाद the foot, and रक्षण protecting.

f. (-ज्जुः)
An elephant's heel-ropes.
E.
पाद, and रज्जु a rope.

mf. (-थः-थी)
A shoe, a slipper.
E.
पाद the foot, and रथ, a vehicle.

m. (-णः)
The Indian fig tree.
E.
पाद, and रोहण what rises.

n. (-नं)
Respect, respectful behaviour.
E.
पाद, and वन्दन saluting.

n. (-कं)
Morbid enlargement of the legs and feet.
E.
पाद the foot, वल्मीक a hillock.

m. (-कः)
A traveller, a way-farer.
E.
पदवी a road, aff. ठक्.

m. (-कः)
A foot-soldier.
E.
पाद a foot, अब to go, &c. aff. इक or ठक्.

f. (-जाः)
A shoe, a slipper.
E.
पाद the foot, वि privative, रजस् dust.

m. (-ब्दः)
The sound or noise of feet.
E.
पाद a foot, and शब्द sound.

ind.
1 Verse by verse, stanza by stanza.
2 Foot by foot.
3 By a fourth.
E.
पाद a verse, शशि aff.

f. (-खा)
A toe.
E.
पाद a foot, शाखा a branch.

m. (-लः)
A hill near a mountain.
E.
पाद the foot, and शैल a hill.

m. (-थः)
Swelling of the feet, gout.
E.
पाद, and शोथ a swelling.

n. (-नं)
Service, duty.
E.
पाद, and सेवन waiting upon.

m. (-टः)
Kibe, chilblain, a sore or ulcer on the foot.
E.
पाद the foot, and स्फोट a boil.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Trodden on, kicked, touched with the feet.
E.
पाद, and हत struck.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kicked, trodden, touched by the foot.
E.
पाद, and आहत struck.

m. (-र्षः)
Tingling of the feet after pressure upon the crural nerves.
E.
